blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has updated its Offline eBIRForms Package to make it easier for qualified micro taxpayers to avail of the one-time abatement program. “We encourage qualified micro taxpayers to take advantage of the One-Time Abatement Program for Micro Taxpayers before the December 31, 2026 deadline. With the updated eBIRForms package, we are making the process easier and more convenient so taxpayers can settle their covered liabilities and return to regular compliance,” Commissioner Charlito Martin Mendoza said. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 104-2026, the BIR announced the availability of Offline eBIRForms Package Version 7.9.6.2, which includes […]...
